footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the reporting person on November 1, 2026 under the Air Water Ventures Limited 2025 Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan"). Each RSU represents the right to receive one ordinary share, par value $0.0001 per share, of the Issuer upon vesting. || The RSUs vest in three equal installments of 350,603 RSUs on each of November 1, 2026, November 1, 2027 and November 1, 2028, subject to the reporting person's continued employment with or service to the Issuer through each applicable vesting date.

Represents ordinary shares withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of 350,603 RSUs on November 1, 2026. The price reported is the fair market value per share used to determine the number of shares withheld, which is the closing price of the ordinary shares on October 30, 2026, the last trading day before the vesting date.
